caveats: Google Business Profile panels (rating, review count, claimed status, photos) were not opened directly for any business; listing figures come from third-party aggregators (Birdeye, BestProsInTown, Healthgrades, Yahoo Local) and may be stale or combine multiple locations.
Where a business has no website, the website_review fields are marked 'no site' rather than guessed.
'🐴' prefixes seen in some browser tab titles were an artifact of the research browser, not of the sites, and are excluded from findings.
